description: This file implements a translator class for FAPI indications to MAC layer messages, including handling of RX data, CRC, UCI, SRS, and RACH indications, with dummy handlers for certain MAC components.

classes.name: mac_cell_rach_handler_dummy
classes.description: Dummy implementation of mac_cell_rach_handler with empty handle_rach_indication method.

classes.name: mac_pdu_handler_dummy
classes.description: Dummy implementation of mac_pdu_handler with empty handle_rx_data_indication method.

classes.name: mac_cell_control_information_handler_dummy
classes.description: Dummy implementation of mac_cell_control_information_handler with empty handle_crc, handle_uci, handle_srs methods.

methods.name: convert_fapi_to_mac_rssi_dB

methods.name: convert_fapi_to_mac_preamble_power_dB
methods.description: Converts FAPI RACH preamble power to optional float in dB.
